The FloPlast end ventilation slate provides an essential, watertight seal for soil pipes passing through rooflines, ensuring secure weather protection for properties. This durable weathering slate features high quality uPVC and an aluminium sheet, designed to fit neatly under roof tiles for a discreet finish that blends seamlessly with existing roof profiles. Its easily mouldable construction suits a wide range of roof pitches and configurations, making it ideal for new installations or replacements in various building projects. A robust rubber adaptor forms a watertight barrier around the soil pipe, preventing water ingress and protecting interior spaces from potential damage.
